## Names

<a id="protection_sig_a"></a>
### [`protection_sig_a`](../../../src/protection_signature.asm#L23) `$CF79-$CF98`

*data*

Copy-protection signature, block A (32 bytes; block B at $CF99). The crack's first stage copies the page $CF00-$CFFF from file address $A700 ($084F). Checks: $512F loops unless $CF8F = $B9 = $CFAF; $06DD needs $CF8F-$CF91 XOR $CFAF-$CFB1 = 0, else an endless store loop; $3189 jumps through ($DE00) when $CF7B/$CF7E/$CF81 equal $CF9B/$CF9E/$CFA1; $0CD8 stores $CF79 XOR $CF99 ($89) in protection_key and $1C13 stores $CF7A XOR $CF9A ($04) in protection_key2, which only play_sound_80_checked tests for 0.

- **Read by:** [`title_screen`](title.md#title_screen) [`$06DF`](../../../src/title.asm#L162) (+22), [`title_screen`](title.md#title_screen) [`$06E5`](../../../src/title.asm#L164) (+23), [`title_screen`](title.md#title_screen) [`$06EB`](../../../src/title.asm#L166) (+24), [`spawn_yamo`](actors.md#spawn_yamo) [`$0CD8`](../../../src/actors.asm#L180), [`main_loop`](main_loop.md#main_loop) [`$1C13`](../../../src/main_loop.asm#L46) (+1), [`update_high_score`](score.md#update_high_score) [`$3189`](../../../src/score.asm#L62) (+2), [`update_high_score`](score.md#update_high_score) [`$3191`](../../../src/score.asm#L66) (+5), [`update_high_score`](score.md#update_high_score) [`$3199`](../../../src/score.asm#L69) (+8), [`build_collision_masks`](collision.md#build_collision_masks) [`$512F`](../../../src/collision.asm#L22) (+22)

### [`protection_sig_b`](../../../src/protection_signature.asm#L41) `$CF99-$CFB8`

*data*

Copy-protection signature, block B (32 bytes). Each check XORs or compares a byte with the byte at the same offset in protection_sig_a; offsets $10-$1F hold the same bytes as block A.
